voice_design_prompt: A 24-year-old storytime YouTuber recording casually into a nearby microphone late at night, talking to the audience like close friends. The delivery is extremely animated and expressive: energetic fast-paced rambling with sudden emphasis spikes on punchlines, playful upward inflections, dramatic gasps, whispered confessions, breathy nervous laughs, quick self-interruptions and wait-no recoveries, exaggerated reactions that instantly drop into a dry flat deadpan, and a sing-song teasing tone on jokes. Naturally imperfect human rhythm with false starts, filler words, audible breaths and mid-sentence topic jumps. Zero narrator tone, zero robotic evenness, zero monotone.
